stem.text: The graph shows the percentage of tuberculosis (TB) patients who were also known to be infected with HIV, from 2004 to 2011.

stem.alt: Line graph of percentage of TB patients against year from 2004 to 2011 on a gridded background, with four lines labelled region P, global, and regions outside region P, and a dotted line for global values.

stem.text: Which statement about the graph is correct?

A.text: From 2004 to 2010, the percentage of TB patients with HIV infection in region P increased from 3% to 69%.

B.text: From 2005 to 2011, the percentage of TB patients with HIV infection increased more rapidly in region P than in regions outside region P.

C.text: From 2006 to 2011, the percentage of TB patients with HIV infection in regions outside region P doubled.

D.text: From 2007 to 2011, the percentage of TB patients with HIV infection globally increased from 20% to 30%.
